items.name: Lemon Spritzer Syrup
items.description: A little sunshine with a serious Italian attitude. Sweet, zesty and dangerously refreshing. Just add soda water, ice, a lemon slice and some crushed mint. Heaven.

items.name: Hot Honey
items.description: Sweet at first. Trouble afterwards. Our signature hot honey brings the perfect balance of sticky sweetness and cheeky heat. Drizzle irresponsibly.

items.name: Limoncello
items.description: Italian sunshine, bottled with a little bad behaviour. Sweet, citrusy and unapologetically zesty. Best served ice-cold, preferably with good company and questionable stories.

items.name: Chilli Sauce
items.description: Small bottle. Big mouth. A fiery little troublemaker that brings heat to everything it touches. You've been warned.

items.name: Chai Spice Blend
items.description: Warm, fragrant and full of character. A beautifully spiced little hug with an Italian-sized personality. Stir, sip and slow down.

items.name: Golden Spice Blend
items.description: Golden goodness with a spicy little swagger. A warming blend of aromatic spices that turns your everyday cup into a golden moment. Stay golden, Rat Pack.
